L141: How to Wear It +
L142: Wear it against bare skin or over a high neckline for contrast. If you stack, go longer and plainer below it. A piece this deliberate earns its own space.

L146: Care is simple. Warm water and a soft brush. Keep it away from perfume and remove before swimming. Check the clasp annually as routine maintenance.

L148: Occasion Guarantee +
L149: Buying this for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it.
L150: Questions Can the length be customized? + Yes. Select your preferred length at checkout. If you need something specific, message us before ordering and we will build it exactly as needed. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond.
L151: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L152: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

L240: ## We are committed to making your entire experience a pleasant one, from ordering to delivery.
L241: Every Draco Diamond piece is built to last. Solid gold settings, not plated. Prongs set to hold. Clasps and links engineered for daily wear, not display. Each stone is IGI certified VS+ clarity minimum, E-F color, individually verified against its grading report before it ships. If a piece does not meet that standard, it does not leave. What arrives at your door is built the way a piece at this price point should be built — and backed by a Lifetime Authenticity Guarantee if it ever falls short.
L242: ### Made to Order
L243: 
L244: +
L245: 
L246: Your piece does not exist until you order it. Every Draco Diamond is made to order in 1 to 2 weeks, then inspected against its IGI certificate before it ships. This is how we guarantee you receive a new piece built to your exact specifications, not something pulled from inventory that has been handled before.
L247: Made to order does not mean harder to return. Our 30-day return window and full refund apply regardless of how your piece was produced. If it is not right, the return process is identical to any standard online purchase.
L248: ### Free Insured Shipping
L249: 
L250: +
L251: 
L252: Every order ships free via fully insured carrier with signature-required delivery and real-time tracking. Your piece arrives in 14 to 21 days from order: 1 to 2 weeks production followed by 2 to 7 days shipping depending on your location. All shipments are insured for the full purchase price at no additional cost. Every order ships delivered duty paid: duties and import taxes are paid by Draco, and nothing is collected at your door.
L253: If you need to send a piece back within 30 days, contact us for return instructions.
L254: ### Discreet Packaging
L255: 
L256: +
L257: 
L258: All shipments arrive in unmarked outer packaging with no external branding or indication of contents. The shipping label shows only our business name. Inside, your piece is presented in full Draco Diamond premium packaging. This protects both security during delivery and the surprise for any gift or proposal.
L259: ### 30-Day Returns
L260: 
L261: +
L262: 
L263: Return any unworn piece within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. No restocking fee. No conditions beyond the piece being unworn and returned with original packaging and IGI documentation.
L264: 
L265: Made to order does not affect this policy. The return process is the same regardless of how your piece was produced. Email info@dracodiamond.com with your order number and we respond within 1 to 3 business days with return instructions and clear next steps.
L266: ### Lifetime Authenticity Guarantee
L267: 
L268: +
L269: 
L270: Every Draco Diamond piece is guaranteed to be exactly what its IGI certificate states. Forever. This covers:
L271:   * Diamond specifications — carat weight, color grade, clarity grade, and cut grade match the IGI certificate exactly
L272:   * Metal purity — 10K, 14K, or 18K gold as specified, verified against stated standards
L273:   * Authenticity — every diamond is an IGI certified lab-grown diamond, chemically identical to mined diamonds
L274:   * Manufacturing integrity — settings, prongs, and clasps built to hold
L275: If the piece ever fails to match what is certified, we fix it, replace it, or refund it in full. Your choice. At no cost to you. This guarantee does not expire.
L276: ### IGI Certified. Every Piece.
L277: 
L278: +

L280: Every diamond is certified by the International Gemological Institute, the world's leading independent grading authority for lab-grown diamonds. Your IGI certificate documents exact carat weight, color grade, clarity grade, cut quality, polish, and symmetry. It is an independent third-party record of exactly what you received.
L281: Every piece is verified against its certificate before it ships. If a piece does not match its IGI specifications, it does not leave. The certificate ships with your order. L137: How to Wear It +
L138: Wear it against bare skin or over a high neckline for contrast. If you stack, go longer and plainer below it. A piece this deliberate earns its own space.
L139: 
L140: White gold for maximum contrast. Yellow gold if you prefer warmth. Rose gold sits between the two. All metals come in solid 10K, 14K, 18K, and Platinum.

L144: Occasion Guarantee +
L145: Buying this for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it.
L146: Questions Can the length be customized? + Yes. Select your preferred length at checkout. If you need something specific, message us before ordering and we will build it exactly as needed. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond.
L147: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L148: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

L220: ## We are committed to making your entire experience a pleasant one, from ordering to delivery.
L221: Every Draco Diamond piece is built to last. Solid gold settings, not plated. Prongs set to hold. Clasps and links engineered for daily wear, not display. Each stone is IGI certified VS+ clarity minimum, E-F color, individually verified against its grading report before it ships. If a piece does not meet that standard, it does not leave. What arrives at your door is built the way a piece at this price point should be built — and backed by a Lifetime Authenticity Guarantee if it ever falls short.
L222: ### Made to Order
L223: 
L224: +
L225: 
L226: Your piece does not exist until you order it. Every Draco Diamond is made to order in 1 to 2 weeks, then inspected against its IGI certificate before it ships. This is how we guarantee you receive a new piece built to your exact specifications, not something pulled from inventory that has been handled before.
L227: Made to order does not mean harder to return. Our 30-day return window and full refund apply regardless of how your piece was produced. If it is not right, the return process is identical to any standard online purchase.
L228: ### Free Insured Shipping
L229: 
L230: +
L231: 
L232: Every order ships free via fully insured carrier with signature-required delivery and real-time tracking. Your piece arrives in 14 to 21 days from order: 1 to 2 weeks production followed by 2 to 7 days shipping depending on your location. All shipments are insured for the full purchase price at no additional cost. Every order ships delivered duty paid: duties and import taxes are paid by Draco, and nothing is collected at your door.
L233: If you need to send a piece back within 30 days, contact us for return instructions.
L234: ### Discreet Packaging
L235: 
L236: +
L237: 
L238: All shipments arrive in unmarked outer packaging with no external branding or indication of contents. The shipping label shows only our business name. Inside, your piece is presented in full Draco Diamond premium packaging. This protects both security during delivery and the surprise for any gift or proposal.

L243: Return any unworn piece within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. No restocking fee. No conditions beyond the piece being unworn and returned with original packaging and IGI documentation.

L246: ### Lifetime Authenticity Guarantee
L247: 
L248: +
L249: 
L250: Every Draco Diamond piece is guaranteed to be exactly what its IGI certificate states. Forever. This covers:
L251:   * Diamond specifications — carat weight, color grade, clarity grade, and cut grade match the IGI certificate exactly
L252:   * Metal purity — 10K, 14K, or 18K gold as specified, verified against stated standards
L253:   * Authenticity — every diamond is an IGI certified lab-grown diamond, chemically identical to mined diamonds
L254:   * Manufacturing integrity — settings, prongs, and clasps built to hold
L255: If the piece ever fails to match what is certified, we fix it, replace it, or refund it in full. Your choice. At no cost to you. This guarantee does not expire.
